description: Every counterparty of an address that analyze_address analyzed in the last hour on this account (without an API key: for the x402 payer whose receipt is given): wallets it sent to or received from and the venues it swapped on, with labels, the native coin (SOL, ETH, BTC, TRX...) and stablecoins moved each way, the number of transactions, and the date and signature of its first and last transfer (for trace_transfer). Covers the transactions that analysis read only. For a token: the wallets in its groups (creator, bundlers, insiders, wallets handed supply) and its top holders. Free, from the earlier analysis; run analyze_address first.

chain.description: Optional: the chain it was analyzed on, for a 0x address analyzed on several EVM chains. The latest analysis otherwise.

filter.description: flagged: threats, sanctioned and mixer counterparties, and look-alike (address poisoning) ones; for a token, its creator, bundlers and insiders. exchange or mixer: only those.

limit.description: How many to list, largest by value first.

receipt.description: Only without an API key: the receipt analyze_address gave when it was paid with x402.

name: get_connections
title: Get an address's connections
